changeSet.author: effectifs

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'eff_conges_campagnes'

changeSet.comment: Campagnes de choix des congés et choix de chacun.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eff_conges_campagnes (tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, nom TEXT NOT NULL, uniteCode TEXT NOT NULL, corpsEmploiCode TEXT NOT NULL, annee INTEGER NOT NULL, du TEXT NOT NULL, au TEXT NOT NULL, codeAbsence TEXT NOT NULL, plafondParSemaine INTEGER NOT NULL, maxSemainesParPersonne INTEGER NOT NULL, etat TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eff_conges_choix (tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, campagneId TEXT NOT NULL, ressourceId TEXT NOT NULL, rang INTEGER NOT NULL, semaine TEXT NOT NULL, statut TEXT NOT NULL, motif TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, campagneId, ressourceId, semaine));
